scope: Necessary structural inputs for future matched physiological and harvest validation; passing does not validate a model or identify a causal loss
grain: One physical plot-season harvest; source_ref/source_plot_id/harvest_year identifies aliases
canopy_scope: Upper three leaf ranks 1,2,3; at least three distinct dated assessments per rank bracketing anthesis through maturity. This is a structural minimum, not evidence that temporal sampling resolves HAD accurately.
observation_requirements: Green/reference LAI and functional impairment must have independent documented measurement methods. Ordinal disease ratings cannot substitute for percent affected leaf area or functional-loss measurements.
split: calibration or validation; no environment or physical harvest may occur in both; at least two validation environments as a coverage screen, not a power criterion
weather: Continuous daily records from sowing through maturity; STB-specific wetness observation/derivation methods and soil-water/nitrogen inputs still require model-specific review
manual_review_required: Provenance and measurement methods; actual access to cited soil/cultivar parameter records
Phenology, canopy representativeness, leaf sampling, temporal resolution, measurement uncertainty and function-to-area interpretation
Frozen model parameters, independent model predictions and benchmarks, split design, power and environmental representativeness
Matched/randomized reference contrasts, disease on both arms, other stresses, and intervention feasibility/cost for causal grain-loss or adaptation claims
Management completeness, intervention dates/amounts, weather derivation, water/nitrogen balance and site-specific agronomy
